articles.mainIdea: Media Advisory - Ontario must register all drivers carrying passengers for money: CTA, Police
articles.summary: CNW Group: Media Advisory - Ontario must register all drivers carrying passengers for money: CTA, Police. As Ontario amends its Highway Traffic Act and reviews regulations for Vehicles for Hire, the Canadian Taxi Association is calling for a centralized database for all ground transportation drivers including Taxi, Uber, Lyft, and local app-based services.
